categories.main_business_segments: Floor & Decor is a multi-channel specialty retailer of hard surface flooring and related accessories with two primary customer segments: professional installers and commercial businesses (Pro), and homeowners (DIY and BIY). The company operates 221 warehouse-format stores across 36 states, averaging 78,000 square feet each, offering tile, wood, laminate, vinyl, natural stone flooring, installation materials, decorative accessories, and adjacent categories. The company also sells commercial surfaces through its Spartan Surfaces subsidiary and recently acquired Salesmaster to expand commercial operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Floor & Decor utilizes a direct sourcing model that bypasses importers, exporters, wholesalers, and distributors to source products directly from manufacturers and quarries in 26 countries. The company employs sophisticated inventory management systems with data-driven forecasting tools based on historical trends, vendor lead times, and SKU-level analysis. Distribution is managed through four strategically located distribution centers with warehouse management and transportation management systems tailored to the company's needs. The company also leverages proprietary brands and collaborates with vendors to design trend-right products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves professional installers and commercial businesses (Pro customers) representing approximately 45% of retail sales, and homeowners (DIY and BIY customers) representing approximately 55% of retail sales. Primary end markets include residential home remodeling, new home construction, and commercial flooring projects. The company operates primarily in the United States across 36 states, with major concentrations in California (27 stores), Texas (31 stores), and Florida (28 stores).
categories.geographic_coverage: Floor & Decor operates 221 warehouse-format stores and five design studios across 36 U.S. states as of December 28, 2023. Major markets include California (27 stores), Texas (31 stores), Florida (28 stores), Georgia (10 stores), Illinois (10 stores), and New York (9 stores). The company has four distribution centers located near Savannah, Houston, Los Angeles, and Baltimore, plus a transload facility near Los Angeles. The company also maintains a sourcing office in Shanghai, China, and serves commercial markets through acquisitions in New York and New England regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Floor & Decor operates at the retail/downstream end of the supply chain as a specialty retailer. However, the company has integrated upstream activities through direct sourcing relationships with manufacturers and quarries in 26 countries, sourcing from over 240 vendors worldwide. The company procures the majority of products directly from manufacturers, eliminating middlemen costs. The company also operates its own distribution infrastructure with four distribution centers and manages inventory from point of manufacture through retail stores and customer delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: opening 30-35 new warehouse-format stores annually targeting 500 stores within eight years; expanding comparable store sales through enhanced product assortment and customer experience; growing the Pro customer segment through dedicated sales teams and technology investments; expanding commercial surfaces business organically and through acquisitions; developing connected customer capabilities through e-commerce and omnichannel integration; investing in design services and in-home consultations; implementing proprietary brands and trend-right products; and enhancing margins through operational leverage and supply chain optimization.
categories.revenue_model: Floor & Decor generates revenue primarily through product sales of hard surface flooring and related accessories in warehouse-format retail stores and through e-commerce. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of inventory, typically at point-of-sale. The company also generates revenue from commercial surfaces sales through Spartan Surfaces and recently acquired Salesmaster. Connected customer sales (online and delivery) represented approximately 19% of total net sales in fiscal 2023. The company maintains an everyday low price strategy rather than relying on frequent promotions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a highly fragmented hard surface flooring market against large home improvement centers (such as The Home Depot and Lowe's), national and regional specialty flooring retailers, independent flooring retailers, and emerging internet-based competitors. The company positions itself as differentiated through its broad in-stock assortment (approximately 4,500 SKUs per store), everyday low prices, warehouse-format stores (larger than competitors), one-stop shopping destination, design services, and specialized Pro customer programs. The company believes it has competitive advantages in direct sourcing, localized assortments, and customer experience.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Floor & Decor is a large accelerated filer with fiscal 2023 net sales of $4.41 billion, up 3.5% from $4.26 billion in fiscal 2022. Net income was $246.0 million in fiscal 2023 compared to $298.2 million in fiscal 2022. Adjusted EBITDA was $551.1 million (12.5% of net sales) in fiscal 2023 compared to $577.1 million (13.5% of net sales) in fiscal 2022. The company has grown from 191 stores at end of fiscal 2022 to 221 stores at end of fiscal 2023. Market capitalization was approximately $10.8 billion as of June 29, 2023. The company is pursuing mid-teens annual percentage growth in store count.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Floor & Decor's value proposition centers on: unparalleled customer value through differentiated assortment (broadest in-stock selection of hard surface flooring), everyday low prices (direct sourcing enables cost advantages), and one-stop project destination with immediate availability. The company offers unique shopping environment with warehouse features, design centers, and knowledgeable staff. For Pro customers, the company provides efficient one-stop shopping, credit offerings, free storage, early hours, dedicated sales teams, loyalty rewards, and design services. The company emphasizes localized product assortment customized to regional preferences, trend-right proprietary brands, and a decentralized culture empowering store-level decision making. The company differentiates through superior customer experience, broad selection, and value pricing.
